title: Word vowels
description: The stressed vowels of common English words, generated from the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary by scripts/make-pron.js (don't edit by hand; add a word to the script's hand-coded list instead). A reading checks each vowel it hears against the vowels of the word being read.

words.description: Code -> space-separated lowercase words. A code has one character per stressed syllable: a vowel key from src/dsp.js (i I e E A a c V o U u r, where A stands for ae) or x for a glide or r-coloured vowel the app doesn't score.
